Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

club — a group of people with the same interest. Example: I would like to join the music club.
group — several people together. Example: Welcome to the group!
join — to become a member. Example: Can I join the club?
member — a person in a club or group. Example: There are twenty members.
meeting — a time when people come together. Example: When is the meeting?
hobby — an activity you enjoy in free time. Example: My hobby is photography.
team — a group that plays or works together. Example: There are twenty members in the team.
sport — a physical game or activity. Example: I do sport every week.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: I love listening to music.
welcome — a friendly greeting when you arrive. Example: Welcome to the club!
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can I join the club?
• When is the meeting?
• I would like to join.
• Welcome to the group!
• How many members are there?
